scope: Local integration critical path, preserving serial production tests. A is the serial control and B uses two isolated UI quality jobs. Standard GitHub-hosted runners, first attempts.
measurement: Earliest successful job start in each phase (plan) to latest successful job completion, including setup, queue after plan and uploads. Runner seconds sum actual elapsed job durations. Independent runner instances; cross-order runs overlap in calendar time. No monetary attribution.
controlAppGitCheckout: Pinned to sourceMain for every measured job; direct comparison covers 116 Chromium commands and 53 cross-engine commands with the same engine bindings. Wallet and unit/syntax ran in every phase.

rows.role: FAST only / UI contract canary — no integration approval

archiveMethod: Checked GitHub size, SHA-256 and every ZIP member CRC. Compared fixed paths by their original workflow role. Timestamped storage diagnostic names were matched by engine, repository stack frames, ordered stages, PASS and the final verified service-worker controller. Compared complete per-engine ui-quality.json records (including scan list, checks and status).
releaseStatus: PR qualification only. Actual Main/Pages/live decision is recorded separately in the roadmap.

queueInclusiveVerification.scope: Original archive readback independently extended to both pairs and PR. Includes the initial plan queue in each phase. For the second A/B phase, starting at the prior job completion instead of next plan creation adds one scheduling second, leaving the decision unchanged.
queueInclusiveVerification.measurementRule: max(B1,B2) < min(A1,A2) and both paired A minus B differences strictly exceed abs(A1 minus A2). Historical comparisons are reported separately.

timing.definition: Elapsed from plan.created_at (first variant equals run.created_at; second released by completion of prior jobs) through last required job.completed_at. runnerSeconds sums job wall-clock, without rounding or charging assumptions. queueSumSeconds is summed across jobs, not added to elapsed. Historical basis starts at plan.started_at.

originals.pathComparison: Regrouped isolated jobs with former job. Normalized only millisecond timestamps in storage-fixture file names, preserving multiplicity.
